_meta.question: Per domain: the expert target for an AI-augmented practitioner, the old projection (LV, round 4), and when the plan reaches senior and expert in role.
_meta.yardstick: Fluency = solves and verifies with AI tools under timed exam conditions and finds planted errors in agent output. Industry = the designer/builder role done with AI, not only the reviewer role.
_meta.milestones: Months from 30.10.2026, P10/P50/P90, from X_model.py (staged waves). 'base' = E2 hours as estimated; 'ai_trend' = agents keep improving (his hours shrink 7%/yr, floor 0.55). senior/expert/principal as defined in X_model.py v2.
